'''Dalin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Dalin was placed in command of [[Task Force Pest]] and unit assembled by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rast'tul|Rast'Tul]] and that was tasked with rounding up [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] civilians on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], so that anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-blocking drugs could be tested on them. When Dalin attempted to have the Force-sensitive vagrant [[Borus Ferthyn]] arrested in [[Gadrin]], a mob protested against this, to Dalin shot Ferthyn, hoping that a display of force would quell the mob. However, it instead lead to riots in the city.

Dalin was later confronted by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] inside [[Thaereian Security Facility Number 12|the prison]] where the Force-sensitives were being held.
